sources.content: OpenAI lists GPT-6 Sol API pricing at $2 input and $10 output per one million tokens and Luna at $0.10 input and $0.50 output per one million tokens. It says Sol and Luna are available in ChatGPT Work and Codex for named plans, Free and Go can access Luna in the desktop app, models are not yet available in Chat, and rollout is gradual. Evaluation environments may differ from production ChatGPT.

The September 22 notes say Sol and Luna are introduced in ChatGPT Work and Codex, separate from models available in Chat. Codex desktop keeps the manually selected model. Available models and reasoning effort options depend on plan and workspace settings.

limits: No individual account or workspace availability is claimed.
Benchmark and price claims remain OpenAI claims and API prices are not subscriptions.
